about: What a promotion gives (console v3 phase 7; decisions 0470 and 0472), in bonus chips or a perk, never rupees. Days are the club's, 06:00 to 06:00 IST, and its weeks run Monday to Sunday. Eligible: the member's tier and audience must be the promotion's (new members have fewer than 30 whole days since joining; lapsed regulars' last visit before this one was 30 or more whole days before). The time-played reward is the play-time (hours) bonus: for it only the minutes inside the schedule at its stakes and tables count, so the moment and table of the event do not matter. For every other reward the event's stake, table and moment must be the promotion's, so a promotion for some stakes gives nothing for an event away from a table. Grant: a seat bonus is its chips on the first seat of a visit, or on any seat when it is for the first N at a table, and in tiers the first tier's chips until the limits set the tier; a play-time bonus pays each step as it is reached (owner, 8 Nov): its one step after a time, its set steps (two to six, rising), or one every so many minutes up to its times a visit and never past 24 hours, each step's chips once its minutes are played, nothing for a step it does not have, and nothing for time played at a visit's close; bonus chips come on a visit, a referral or a sign-up; a cab home from the Nth visit of the calendar month; an entry or waitlist priority on a visit; nothing comes to nothing. Limits, in this order: the member's period already given as often as it allows, once unless it says up to N (2 to 20) times (the same visit, club day, club week, ever, or with no limit the same event, and for a play-time bonus step that period @ the step's place among the promotion's steps, the first 1, so the limit holds for each step and a version that moves a step's minutes never pays it twice (the owner, 9 Nov), and with no limit a step's period is its visit; each grant in a period is keyed as the member's Nth there, the first by the period itself, then #2 and on), the first N seats per table, which counts this promotion's grants at that table this club day, members a day (a member already given it today is not a new one), the most grants, and the budget in bonus chips, whole or not at all; a monthly budget and most grants count the grants of the event's calendar month of club days alone, starting again at 06:00 IST on the first. Stacking for one event: bonus chips from different promotions stack; one perk of each kind, the first given. Inputs are written as the database holds them. A high hand bonus (redesign RD-22) lists hands from a fixed list (royal flush, straight flush, four of a kind, Aces full, any full house), each with its own Bonus, and holds rules: both hole cards must play, shown at showdown, and a least number of players dealt in. The floor logs a hit: a hand, its rank where the hand has one (a straight flush's high card, king to five; which four of a kind; the three of a full house; none for a royal flush or Aces full), and each rule confirmed. A hit pays its listed hand's Bonus, whole, every time: a full house of three aces is Aces full where the promotion lists it and any full house otherwise; a hand not listed, a rank the hand cannot have, or a rule the promotion holds left unconfirmed (the players dealt in always) pays nothing and says which, the first in that order. Its only limit is the promotion's budget, which it must have, whole or not at all; what is left of a budget is the budget less what was paid, never below nothing.

cases.description: Everyone, every stake, Tuesdays: a seat at 21:00 on Tuesday qualifies.
Tuesdays: a seat at 21:00 on Wednesday does not.
Only 100/200: a seat at 50/100 does not qualify.
Only 100/200: a seat at 100/200 qualifies.
Only 100/200: an event away from a table has no stake, so it does not qualify.
Only Table 1: a seat at Table 2 does not qualify.
Only Founders' Circle: a Founders' Circle member qualifies.
Only Founders' Circle: a member with no tier does not.
New members, first 30 days: 29 whole days since joining qualifies.
New members, first 30 days: 30 whole days since joining does not.
Lapsed regulars: last here 30 days ago qualifies.
Lapsed regulars: last here 29 days ago does not.
Lapsed regulars: a member who never came before is not a lapsed regular.
Play-time bonus, Friday 20:00 to 02:00 at 100/200: a visit closing at 03:00 on Saturday still qualifies; only its time inside the window at that stake earns.
Play-time bonus for Founders' Circle only: a member with no tier does not qualify.
1,000 bonus chips after four hours, its one step: 3 hours 59 minutes is too short.
1,000 bonus chips after four hours, its one step: four hours exactly gives 1,000.
A play-time bonus weighs only its steps: time played at close gives it nothing.
500 after two hours, then 1,000 after four: the four-hour step at 4 hours 10 minutes gives 1,000.
500 after two hours, then 1,000 after four: the two-hour step gives 500.
500 after two hours, then 1,000 after four: three hours is not one of its steps.
250 every 1.5 hours, twice a visit: the second step, at three hours, gives 250.
250 every 1.5 hours, twice a visit: a third step, at 4.5 hours, is past its cap.
50 every 12 hours: the 24-hour step a minute early is too short.
50 every 12 hours: the 24-hour step itself gives 50, the last of a day's play.
1,000 bonus chips on each visit: a visit gives 1,000.
1,000 bonus chips for a referral: the referral gives 1,000.
500 bonus chips on sign-up: the sign-up gives 500.
Bonus chips on a referral are not given for a visit.
Bonus chips on a visit are not given for a sign-up.
A cab home from the fourth visit in a month: the third visit is not yet.
A cab home from the fourth visit in a month: the fourth visit gives it.
A tournament entry is given on a visit.
Waitlist priority is given on a visit.
A seat bonus is not given for time played.
No limits and nothing given yet: given.
A budget of 5,000 with 4,000 given: a grant of 1,000 uses the last of it.
Budget exhausted mid-grant: 5,000 with 4,500 given cannot give 1,000, and never gives part of it.
Once per member: a member who has had it does not have it again.
First 5 seats at a table: a seat away from a table cannot count among them.
50 members a day: a 51st member is not given it.
50 members a day: one of the 50 already given it today may have it again, as the per-member limit allows.
50 members a day: the 50th member is given it.
At most 100 grants: the 100th is given.
At most 100 grants: the 101st is not given.
Up to twice a day: a member given it once today has it again.
Up to twice a day: a member given it twice today has it no more.
Up to three times ever: the third is let through.
A monthly budget of 10,000 chips with 9,000 given this month: 1,000 more is let through, at the cap.
A monthly budget of 10,000 chips with 9,000 given this month: 1,050 more is not, never part of it.
At most 10 grants a month, 10 given this month: no more this month.
A monthly budget with nothing given this month: a zero-chip grant is let through.
Bonus chips from two promotions stack.
Two cabs home for one visit: one cab.
Nothing to give: none.
A whole budget counts every grant, in every month.
A monthly budget counts the grants of the event's club month only: 05:59 IST on 1 December is still 30 November.
From 06:00 IST on 1 December a monthly budget starts again from nothing.
A member's grants in the period are counted with their numbered keys, not another member's or another day's.
Per club day: 02:00 IST is still the day before.
Per club week: Monday to Sunday, by the club day.
Per visit: the visit.
Per visit with no visit: the event.
Once ever.
No limit: the event itself.
Up to twice a day: the member's second grant today is numbered 2.
Up to 20 times ever: the twentieth is numbered 20.
1,000 after four hours: 3 hours 59 minutes reaches no step.
1,000 after four hours: four hours reaches its step.
500 after two hours, then 1,000 after four: 1 hour 59 minutes reaches none.
500 after two hours, then 1,000 after four: 4 hours 10 minutes reaches both.
250 every 1.5 hours, twice a visit: ten hours reaches two steps, its cap.
50 every 12 hours, no cap: a day's play reaches two steps, never past 24 hours.
50 every 12 hours, no cap: nothing played reaches nothing.
A play-time bonus step per visit: the visit and @ the step's place, the first.
A play-time bonus step per club day, its second time: the day, @ its place, #2.
A play-time bonus step with no limit: its visit, @ its place.
A play-time step: the period @ its place among the steps (the owner, 9 Nov).
A step a new version moved to other minutes is still the same step, so it is never paid twice.
A step with no limit: its visit, as a step is paid once a visit.
A seat bonus on the first seat of a visit: its 1,000 bonus chips.
A seat bonus on a later seat of the visit: nothing.
A seat bonus for the first 5 at a table pays a later seat of the visit too: the limit counts them.
The smallest seat bonus, 50 bonus chips, is paid whole.
Bonus chips on a visit are not paid for a seat.
First 5 seats at a table: the fifth is.
First 5 seats at a table: the sixth is not.
A seat bonus with no first N is not held to a count at the table.
First 5 seats at a table: a member already paid today takes no second place, even with places left.
A seat bonus in tiers on a member's first seat of a visit: the first tier's 5,000 chips, which the limits set to the tier reached.
A seat bonus in tiers on a later seat of the visit: nothing.
Tiers of the first 10 at 5,000 and the next 20 at 2,000: the first claim is in the first tier.
The tenth claim, the last of the first 10: still 5,000.
The eleventh claim: the next tier, 2,000.
The thirtieth claim, the last of the next 20: still 2,000.
Every tier claimed: nothing more.
A seat bonus in tiers with claims left: given.
A seat bonus in tiers with every tier claimed: stopped.
A member already given a seat bonus in tiers: already given, whatever the tiers.
The budget counts the tier's chips: 4,000 of 6,000 given, the eleventh claim at 2,000 is given.
While the first claim at 5,000 would pass the same budget: stopped.
High hand: a royal flush listed at 25,000 pays 25,000.
High hand: a straight flush, nine high, pays its 10,000.
High hand: four jacks pay the four of a kind, 5,000.
High hand: Aces full pays its own 2,000, not any full house's 1,000.
High hand: a full house logged with three aces is Aces full where the promotion lists it: 2,000.
High hand: kings full pays any full house, 1,000.
High hand: Aces full where only any full house is listed is a full house: 500.
High hand: the smallest Bonus, 50, is paid whole.
High hand: kings full where only Aces full is listed is not a listed hand.
High hand: four of a kind where the promotion lists none is not a listed hand.
High hand: four of a kind with no rank named is refused for its rank.
High hand: a straight flush cannot be ace high, which is a royal flush.
High hand: a straight flush cannot be four high.
High hand: a straight flush, five high, the lowest there is, pays.
High hand: a royal flush has no rank to name.
High hand: both hole cards not confirmed is refused, and says so.
High hand: not confirmed as shown at showdown is refused, and says so.
High hand: the players dealt in not confirmed is refused, and says so.
High hand: with two rules unconfirmed, the first is the one named.
High hand: a promotion that does not hold the hole cards or showdown rules pays without them confirmed.
High hand: but the players dealt in are always confirmed.
A high hand bonus is not paid for a seat.
A seat bonus is not paid for a high hand.
High hand order: a hand not listed, with no rank and a rule unconfirmed, is refused as not listed.
High hand order: a listed hand with no rank and a rule unconfirmed is refused for its rank.
High hand order: showdown and the players dealt in both unconfirmed: showdown is named.
High hand order: a full house of three aces where only Aces full is listed pays Aces full, 2,000.
Paid as: four jacks are a four of a kind, jacks.
Paid as: a royal flush, with no rank.
Paid as: a full house with three aces is Aces full where it is listed, and Aces full has no rank.
Paid as: Aces full where only any full house is listed is a full house, aces.
Paid as: kings full is a full house, kings.
Paid as: nothing where the hand is not listed.
High hand budget: 10,00,000 with 5,00,000 paid: a royal flush's 25,000 is paid.
High hand budget: 50,000 with 25,000 paid: a royal flush's 25,000 uses the last of it.
High hand budget: 50,000 with 30,000 paid: 25,000 more is not paid, nor part of it.
High hand budget: the smallest hit, 50, past a spent budget is not paid.
Budget left: 50,000 with 30,000 paid leaves 20,000.
Budget left: 50,000 with nothing paid leaves it all.
Budget left: a budget all paid leaves nothing.
Budget left: more paid than a budget since made smaller still leaves nothing, never less.
